blocks.content: The founding stakeholder document (draft 2026-09-11): a local-only LLM desktop app that looks like Codex/ChatGPT, supports multitasking with projects and tabs, runs exclusively on Ollama/llama.cpp, has no call-home behavior, and — as a hard constraint — never destroys the hard drive. §4 lists the six core requirement groups (chat/workspace, backends, no-call-home, automation, bounded storage, JSON+MD data model); §8 the license posture that drove the MIT/Apache-only dependency audit.
Bounded logs, bounded sessions, controlled temp, cleanup rules, visible usage, safe defaults, manual override — every release audit re-checks this section.
OpenCode/Jan/Cline/Continued/LM Studio evaluated; the app-behavior references shaped the v1 UI.
